name: io.github.p31labs.mcp-membrane
title: P31 Membrane
description: Post-deploy verification MCP server — DORA metrics, deploy checks, gamified XP/LOVE rewards, and artifact minting. Runs locally via npx.

tools.name: membrane_status
tools.description: Get Membrane system status — XP, LOVE balance, level, streak, and unlocked achievements

tools.name: membrane_dora
tools.description: Get DORA metrics — deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, and mean time to restore

tools.name: membrane_history
tools.description: Get deploy history with check results — pass/fail per check, durations, and XP earned

tools.name: membrane_achievements
tools.description: List all unlocked achievements with tier (bronze/silver/gold/platinum) and unlock timestamps

tools.name: membrane_deploy_check
tools.description: Record a deploy check result and earn XP/LOVE rewards — accepts deployId, check name, category, pass/fail, message, and duration

tools.name: membrane_dora_scorecard
tools.description: Get a formatted DORA scorecard with color-coded status per metric and overall score out of 100

tools.name: membrane_artifact_mint
tools.description: Mint a physical artifact from an achievement — generates a unique serial number with verification URL
